title: Add gestures to the widget
line: Swiping two fingers left or right over the Media Player widget now goes to the previous or next track.
explanation: The Media Player widget's scroll handler treated horizontal scrolling the same as vertical scrolling, so a two-finger left/right swipe on a touchpad only changed the volume and there was no gesture for changing track. Two-finger up/down already changes the volume, which covers that part of the request. The change makes horizontal scrolling go to the previous or next track instead: once per touchpad swipe (the swipe is tracked through Qt's scroll phases, so a long swipe never skips several tracks) and once per notch on a tilting mouse wheel. It also works on the media icon in the system tray, which uses the same compact representation.

commits.message:
applets/mediacontroller: change track with horizontal scrolling

Horizontal scrolling over the widget used to change the volume like the
vertical one. It now goes to the previous or next track, once per swipe
on a touchpad or once per notch on a tilting mouse wheel.

BUG: 460588

media.caption: Before: scrolling left twice and right twice over the panel widget only changes the volume (player log: 6 SetVolume calls); the track stays "Track 3".
After: the same scrolls go to Track 2, Track 1, then back to Track 2 and Track 3 (player log: Previous, Previous, Next, Next; volume unchanged).
